_comment: Build matrix for XC_VM_FFMPEG. Source of truth for local builds is the bash arrays in build_ffmpeg_all.sh; this file mirrors them for humans/CI. Keep in sync.

ffmpeg_versions._comment: panel label -> ffmpeg release tarball to compile per-distro (all GPU-enabled). 4.0 rebuilt from 4.4.5; the XUI '-nofix_dts' custom flag is absent from stock ffmpeg (native dca decode still works) — panel must stop sending it.

nv_codec_headers._comment: per-ffmpeg-version nv-codec-headers tag (n12 is too new for 4.x).

distros._comment: distro tag (asset suffix) -> docker base image. debian_11 dropped: Debian 11 LTS ended 2026-08, security pool removed from mirrors so apt can no longer install build deps (ubuntu_20 has the same glibc 2.31). Rocky_9 is TODO: build_ffmpeg.sh is apt-only and needs a dnf port of install_build_tools.

codecs._comment: Target codec/feature set, chosen from what XC_VM code actually invokes (see README). Not the union of the three deployed builds.
